repos.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库聚合中国独立开发者项目，涵盖AI工具、桌面应用、浏览器插件等多元领域。项目注重本地优先与用户体验，技术栈包括AI大模型、跨平台开发，助力开发者、创业者及学生洞察趋势、促进技术交流。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates Chinese independent developer projects across AI tools, desktop apps, browser extensions, and more. Emphasizing local-first design and user experience, it leverages AI large models and cross-platform tech, serving as a resource for developers, entrepreneurs, and students to explore trends and foster exchange.

repos.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis
repos.summary_zh: OpenList是AList的社区分支，通过长期治理应对信任危机，保障开源健康。集成多云存储，支持阿里云盘、OneDrive、GoogleDrive等，及本地存储与FTP。基于AGPL-3.0许可，强调透明共治。提供统一的多云文件管理平台。
repos.summary_en: OpenList is a community-driven fork of AList, aiming to ensure open-source integrity through long-term governance. It integrates multiple cloud storages like Aliyundrive, OneDrive, GoogleDrive, and supports local and FTP. Licensed under AGPL-3.0, it values transparency and community governance. The project provides a unified multi-cloud file management platform for individuals and businesses.
